What this does not model

Tax here is a graduated federal and provincial approximation, not the Income Tax Act: surtaxes, most credits and several province-specific rules are absent. Within that, the gaps worth knowing are the ones no tooltip mentions. Every dividend is treated as an eligible Canadian one, so foreign dividends belong in the interest box instead. Non-registered holdings carry a single pooled cost base per person rather than one per security, with no capital losses and no superficial-loss rule, and gains accrue untaxed until sold — which fits a buy-and-hold ETF holder and flatters a fund that distributes gains yearly. On the RDSP, the taxable share of a plan you already hold rests on the one percentage you enter rather than a real contribution history; provincial disability benefits and their income tests are not modelled at all; and there is no Canada Disability Savings Bond calculation, so low-income years that would attract it earn nothing here.

Privacy

The numbers you type never leave your browser — there is no server behind this page, and nothing you enter is uploaded, stored or transmitted anywhere.

No AI in the maths

Nothing on this page asks a language model what your money does. Every figure comes from arithmetic written out in the source of this file — brackets, rates and rules you can read, in order, and check against the CRA's own tables. That is the point of shipping it unminified: you are not asked to trust a model, or us, only to read it. The file was written with AI assistance, as most software now is; the calculation itself contains none, makes no network request of any kind, and gives the same answer every time from the same inputs.

Source, and where to report a problem

The whole calculator is one file, and this is it — nothing is fetched, so what you are reading is what ran. Source, releases and issues: github.com/christhefarmer/runway. A wrong number is worth reporting even if you are not certain: say which fields you entered and what you expected, and it can be checked against the tax tables. Bracket and benefit figures are re-verified periodically, and the date they were last checked is shown above the results.
